definitions.explanation: To be directed or oriented in a particular direction.
To be appropriate or fitting for a purpose.

examples.japanese: この{仕事|しごと}は{私|わたし}に向いている。

notes:
{向|む}く is an intransitive godan verb meaning to face a direction or be suited for something.

TRANSITIVITY PAIR:
- {向|む}く ({自動詞|じどうし}): to face (intransitive)
- {向|む}ける ({他動詞|たどうし}): to direct toward (transitive)

DIRECTION (facing):
- {東|ひがし}を{向|む}く: to face east
- {前|まえ}を{向|む}く: to face forward
- {上|うえ}を{向|む}く: to look up
- {下|した}を{向|む}く: to look down
- {右|みぎ}を{向|む}く: to face right

SUITABILITY (〜に{向|む}いている):
- この{仕事|しごと}に{向|む}いている: to be suited for this job
- {教師|きょうし}に{向|む}いている: to be suited to be a teacher
- {一人暮|ひとりぐ}らしに{向|む}いている: to be suited for living alone

RELATED:
- {向|む}かう: to head toward
- {向|む}こう: the other side, over there
